feature: T11 blue and cream inner island and outer apron
registration: Same car, HUD 56.223→57.121→58.023. This is fast playback and not a linear metric station clock. T11 is the left bend at native approximately 3233 m.

inside.method: Two-metre longitudinal cells clipped to the existing native physical corridor and road exclusion. Cream paving uses the local road branch plane at +2 mm. Blue paint projects to those actual triangles at +7 mm. Existing grass is removed only beneath this occupied paving.

outside.method: Replace incorrect green base with blue within the original apron. Cream paint projects to the existing emitted apron at +5 mm.

dimensions_policy: Palette and island identity are direct observations. Exact reaches and band widths are visual estimates, not a survey. Native road, widths, elevation, physical corridor, barriers and driving surfaces remain unchanged.
